Prerequisites: Plague Bringer necromancy talent

Through the necromancer's study of diseases, he has learned the secrets of how they spread and, more importantly, how to call a disease down on those who have slighted him. As a standard action, he can sicken one creature within 25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels for a number of rounds equal to his Charisma modifier (Fort save DC 10 + half of the necromancer's level + his Charisma modifier to negate). This is a disease effect. Each round the target is sickened by this ability, he may take a move action to spread the contagion. By doing so, each enemy adjacent to the original target at the start of its turn is sickened for 1 round (Fort save negates). He may use this ability a number of times per day equal to his Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
